name: Ride909
description:
Hold the pad and tap with the kick: the nearest clock becomes step 1, and a 4-step cycle plays the off-beat 909 ride (step 3) with kick sidechain on step 1. Pitch matches the hardware Tune pot (−6.1…+9.5 st).
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: PITCH
params.detail: 909 Tune: panel mid = 35 kHz (MARS mid); pot span ≈−6.1…+9.5 st; decay tracks pitch

params.name: PUMP
params.detail: Kick sidechain amount (bottom = off, top = near-silent duck)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Drum level attenuator (Audio In always full)

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Soft VCA choke; max = full address envelope (hardware)

params.name: GAIN
params.detail: Ride boost above unity (0 = 0 dB, max ≈ +12 dB); soft-clips when boosted
